_comment: Golden O/X/Draw counts for 10000 games. Every implementation is
deterministic: fixed seed, fixed shuffle, 64-bit integer arithmetic only,
so these values are identical on x86_64 and aarch64.
The counts differ between languages because the seeds differ. ttt.c,
ttt.cc, ttt-mt.cc, ttt.go and ttt.ml all seed the shared xorshift with
1729163 and must agree exactly - that is identical_group. ttt.rs seeds
1729, ttt.js seeds 172916342314, and ttt.py / ttt.java use their standard
library generators, so each stands alone.
ttt-alt.c is a different game entirely: 40x40 board, win condition 12.

known_broken.lean: ttt.lean does not compile on any Lean 4 toolchain. Board.update is never defined; checkWin is declared (x y : Nat) (b : Board) but called with five arguments; shuffle discharges its bounds obligations with `by sorry`; and checkWin's b.set calls discard their results, so the writes would be no-ops even if it built. Delete this entry and add a golden once ttt.lean is a working program - it seeds the same xorshift with 1729163, so it belongs in identical_group.
